free_tier.stated: USD 3.89 per month for cvm.pico in the Cost Optimized series: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 15 GB NVMe, 1 TB of outbound transfer a month, as the pricing page's table prints. The page prints monthly terms only; no annual or quarterly price appears on any page read. The terms state card plans renew automatically at the end of each billing period for a new period of the same length at the renewal price shown at checkout, and crypto or account-credit plans renew by invoice instead. The order flow is the console at console.arct.cloud behind a sign-up gate (e-mail address and password, or Google, Discord or GitHub sign-in), so the cart's own term prices are unverified: behind a sign-up. No sold-out marker on the pricing page. Overage beyond the allowance is USD 0.01 per GB, USD 0.02 per GB in Tokyo.

egress.terms: Outbound transfer is counted per plan: 1 TB a month on cvm.pico up to 6 TB a month on cvm.xlarge in the Cost Optimized series, 5 to 10 TB in the General Purpose and High Performance series; inbound is free and not counted. Overage above the allowance costs USD 0.01 per GB, or USD 0.02 per GB in Tokyo. Backups and snapshots are billed separately.
